intro: Djibouti is one of the hottest and driest countries, with salt lakes below sea level.

chapters.title: Land
text: Lake Assal, at about 155 m below sea level, is the lowest point in Africa and one of the saltiest lakes on Earth. Lac Abbé has limestone chimneys that puff steam.

chapters.title: Sea
text: Whale sharks gather in the Gulf of Tadjoura each winter.

keyTerms.meaning: A lake with very salty water.

places.title: Landscape tour
places.intro: Places that show the variety of Djibouti's landscapes. The numbers match the pins on the map.
